domain: Experiment design and causal identification inside an agent runtime — arm comparability and cross-arm contamination, budget-currency and compaction covariates, pre-registered rate and stopping rules, outcome measurability from existing evidence channels; joined to harness enforcement semantics: forward-only phase sequences, gate vocabularies, who or what fires a trigger, and whether multi-agent topology is observable at all.
axioms: An arm difference that is confounded with the treatment by construction cannot be repaired by more samples; the design must be fixed before any arm runs.

A pilot outcome only counts if the channel that would record it exists today or is explicitly built by the plan — outcomes recoverable only from abandoned sessions or from a store no consumer reads are not outcomes.
Equal budget is meaningless until the currency is named, because arms that differ by parking material in context differ in whichever currency is not being metered.

A verdict about runtime phasehood is a claim about mechanism: if no state machine, gate, trigger, or routing decision would differ tomorrow under the opposite answer, the verdict is a naming preference wearing an engineering costume.
The cheapest measurement that could retire the whole field should gate the expensive ones, not run beside them.
A treatment with no automatic trigger is measuring the operator, not the design; and a metric with no pre-declared losing value cannot lose.
Criteria that name an interaction the harness makes unobservable — topology, multi-agent coherence — will be answered in prose and then weighted as if they were evidence.
primitives: arm, treatment, and the covariate that differs by construction rather than by assignment
store namespace and the contamination path between arms
budget currency (billing versus context) and the meter that denominates it
compaction/turn-allowance schedule as an uncontrolled covariate
trigger authority — what fires the treatment when no human is present
outcome channel: where a result is written and which consumer reads it
identification cell (a 2×2 whose four readings must be distinguishable)
pre-declared losing outcome and the degenerate behavior that would satisfy the metric instead
enforcement seat: the state machine, gate, or config a candidate could actually occupy
observability of multi-agent topology in the running system
failure_mode: Measurement absolutism — can demand instrumentation for questions that are genuinely taste or judgment calls, and will propose a proxy metric rather than concede a human decision.

Mechanism tunnel vision: judges a candidate by whether the runtime can express it today, which systematically favors incumbents and undervalues designs whose value depends on a change the runtime has not yet made.
No vocabulary for semantic distinctness, mnemonic load, or conceptual economy, so it under-serves the semantic-operation verdict entirely.
Cannot adjudicate inherited claim status; will treat a cited file:line as settled without asking whether the finding was ever verified.
Cost-blind in the other direction — a rigorous arm design it proposes may be more expensive than the decision it informs.
Risks re-filing already-catalogued runtime defects as new findings because it reasons from the code upward rather than from this charter's specific instructions downward.
